title: Body-only revision adding a new colour (+50% value) plus a status question
subject: CV-5521 – add colour
body:
Hola Karthik,

For order CV-5521 please add a third colour, Peach Fizz, 600 pcs: 0-3M 150 / 3-6M 300 / 6-12M 150. Same price. That makes 1.800 pcs in total.

Also, you still haven't told us the earliest ex-factory date – when can you ship?

Gracias,
Lucía
Casa Verdemar S.L.
